<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that, in the forward direction, breaks a carboxylic ester (C‑O bond) and forms a C‑C bond, matching the cycloaddition description.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
  "functional_groups_formed": null,
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "bonds_broken": null,
  "bonds_order_changed": null,
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
